Backend: new tests/test_oftalmologia.py 8/8 PASS (schema incl. sub min/max, prism, DIP, contact lens fields; seeded Marco Demo visit with cristallino nota and Lacrime artificiali OO; PATCH persist+restore; live AI run: 'cristallino con lieve opacità' -> campi.cristallino.nota with od/os empty, cornea 'entrambi' -> od+os, numbers kept as dictated '-2,25', axis '90', OS cylinder/axis left empty; timololo OS, lacrime artificiali occhio '' (not said); base note.terapia contains no drops; PDF prints OD:/OS: lines and 'Occhio non specificato:' and skips empty fields). Malformed PATCH (string in occhi / terapia_occhi) is sanitized by clean_value, PDF still 200. Regression: test_cardio_lab_placement PASS; test_mantai_faithfulness flaky (1 of 3 runs failed). Frontend: oculista visit has 5 tabs (Anamnesi, Motivo e sintomi, Esame obiettivo, Esami strumentali, Diagnosi e terapia); OD/OS columns side by side at 1920 and stacked OD-then-OS at 390 with no horizontal overflow; plausibility works for asse 195 / cilindro 12 / addizione 5 / tonometria 90 / sfera -31 (Correggi clears only that sub-field, Confermo keeps the value; +2,25 and 17 do not trigger it); Rimuovi nota, palpebre edit and a new drop row persist after Salva + reload (seeded visit restored through the API afterwards); 'Occhio non indicato' badge and the OD/OS/OO single-select toggle work. Cardiology pressione Correggi clears only the out-of-range sis or dia, numero Correggi clears the value, gyn eta_menarca 99 Correggi works. TeamPanel placeholder 'Codice fiscale del paziente' (placeholder text-transform none). ConsentGate ok color rgb(168,221,190) on the dark overlay (~rgb(15,26,30) + 10% white), so AA passes.

minor.issue: Flaky test_mantai_faithfulness (failed 1 of 3 runs): the riepilogo explained ECG as 'ritmo del cuore che parte dal suo normale centro di comando', so the patient summary used the word 'normale', which the doctor never said. A prompt fix is needed: glossary explanations must not use judgement words.

Where the follow-up goes is inconsistent: in the seeded visit 'Controllo tra un anno con campo visivo' went into module accertamenti with base follow_up empty, while in the AI test 'Controllo tra sei mesi' went into base follow_up. Each is a single field, so nothing is duplicated, but the placement should be the same every time.

ui_bugs.issue: At desktop the plausibility alert renders inside the narrow sub-field grid cell (~70px wide in a 4-column refrazione grid). The text wraps into a tall narrow box and the 'Correggi' button overflows the box border. Render the alert below the whole OD/OS sub-grid (col-span-full) or in a popover.

issues: When the unit is empty the text reads 'conferma 195 ?' with a stray space before '?'
The 'Bodychart' button shows for Oftalmologia, where it is probably not relevant (minor, product decision)
